# uptimekuma_tag (Resource)

A tag that can be attached to monitors. Tags are shared across the whole Uptime Kuma instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_tag" "environment" {
  name  = "environment"
  color = "#4B5563"
}

resource "uptimekuma_monitor_http" "web" {
  name = "Web"
  url  = "https://example.com"

  tags = [
    {
      tag_id = uptimekuma_tag.environment.id
      value  = "production"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `color` (String) Color used in the dashboard, as a CSS hex value such as `#4B5563`.
- `name` (String) Name of the tag.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the tag, assigned by Uptime Kuma.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Monitors, tags, notifications and the rest are imported by their numeric ID,
# which is visible in the Uptime Kuma URL when you open the object.
terraform import uptimekuma_tag.example 3
```
